method: Fresh anonymous official Edge; expose webpack loader, load five actual lazy extension modules without installing or connecting hardware, call unchanged official domain factories and event predicates, inspect official panels and registration, convert authored code using official code-view converter. Read local VM branch names without changing Rust.
limitations: Empty hardware map only; connected devices and installed-but-disconnected cores were not measured.
Direct domain calls are not native project execution. Promise fulfillment does not establish native scheduling; all commands remain deferred.
Event specs and isolated predicates are not live event-dispatch tests. No device events were injected into a running project.
Panel argument order is not a proof of child-expression VM evaluation order. Domain property reads do not authorize input elision.
A local exact-name VM branch proves a path exists, not semantic completeness. Registration and code conversion do not prove playback behavior.
The 41 registered types are existing VM paths, not new missing features; negative converter results do not establish unreachability.
